results.title: Pressure Cooker
results.overview: Four women are pushed to their breaking point in Dhaka’s underbelly, where the only way to survive systemic exploitation is to stop being the prey and start being the threat.

results.title: MR-9: Do or Die
results.overview: Elite Bangladeshi CIA agent Masud Rana – codename MR-9 – teams up with an American CIA operative to bring down an international criminal organization headed by a ruthless businessman.

results.title: Happily Married
results.overview: Anis and Anamika are complete opposites, brought together by an unexpected marriage. Can the responsible Anis and the free-spirited, modern Anamika overcome their differences and build a happy life together?

results.title: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
results.overview: A few mysterious men from Kochi arrive out of nowhere and whisk away the ever-baffling Eken Babu to Kerala. As confusion turns into curiosity, Eken finds himself at the centre of a bizarre new mystery.

results.title: Ferar Poth Nei Thake Na Kono Kaale
results.original_title: ফেরার পথ নেই থাকে না কোন কালে

results.title: The Expedition
results.overview: Narsingh, a North Indian taxi driver, attempts to reinvent his life by visiting his native place, but instead gets embroiled in a local Marwari businessman's smuggling and human trafficking business.

results.title: Gangor
results.overview: Sent to cover a story on the exploitation of tribal people, Upin meets a woman he believes is the epitome of Indian beauty. His pictures of her change both of their lives forever.

results.title: DeSu7
results.overview: After years apart, two people reunite for a fresh start. A story of deep emotion, romance, and action about love that endures and a reunion destined to happen.

results.title: Roid
results.overview: A solitary middle aged man marries a madwoman and builds a house on a vacant plot of land far from the village. However, his wife’s madness becomes a calamity in his tranquil life.

results.title: Bonolota Express
results.overview: On a foggy winter journey, the Bonolota Express carries strangers burdened by secrets whose lives begin to collide within the train’s confined corridors. As the night unfolds, personal and political crises erupt, exposing hidden grief, moral decay, and moments of unexpected compassion amid chaos and revolt. By dawn, the train moves on, leaving its passengers irrevocably changed by a single journey where illusions collapse and human truths emerge.

results.title: Char Satiner Ghar
results.overview: Based on the novel "Hridoy O Sromer Songsar" by Selina Hossain. KDesperate for an heir to his vast wealth, wealthy villager Khan shaheb Kashem Khan marries for a fourth time to Fulbanu. Caught between her lifelong dreams and harsh reality, Fulbanu navigates the complex dynamics of a polygamous household.

results.title: The Music Room
results.overview: An aging, decadent landlord’s passion for music becomes the undoing of his legacy as he sacrifices his wealth in order to compete with the opulent music room of his younger, richer neighbour.

results.title: Lost Land
results.overview: In the hope of reuniting with their scattered family, four-year-old Shafi and his nine-year-old sister Somira leave a Rohingya refugee camp in Bangladesh on a perilous journey to reach Malaysia.

results.title: Pather Panchali
results.overview: Impoverished priest Harihar Ray, dreaming of a better life for himself and his family, leaves his rural Bengal village in search of work. Alone, his wife, Sarbojaya, looks after her rebellious daughter, Durga, and her young son, Apu, as well as Harihar's elderly aunt Indir. The children enjoy the small pleasures of their difficult life, while their parents suffer the daily indignities heaped upon them.

results.title: Rakkhosh
results.overview: The story about a man pushed to his limits by love and greed, who eventually embraces his darker side to seek justice or revenge in a world filled with "monsters."

results.title: Female 4
results.overview: In a peaceful battery goli, where everyone took an oath not to fight amongst themselves, chaos ensues as another Female hops into the scene.

results.title: You Will Never Find a Country Like This Anywhere
results.original_title: এমন দেশটি কোথাও খুঁজে পাবে নাকো তুমি
results.overview: Set against the backdrop of the 37th anniversary of Bangladesh's independence, this psychological drama-thriller explores the intricate social, psychological, and political realities of post-independence Bangladesh. The narrative follows deeply human struggles that mirror the broader challenges, corruption, and evolving state of the nation, blending suspense with sharp socio-political commentary.

results.title: Blind Road
results.overview: Completed in 2019, this short film remained unreleased for years before finally premiering at various film festivals in 2025, where it screened to critical acclaim and won multiple awards. In 2026, it made its official broadcast debut on television and was released online for global audiences.  Driven by Dhaka's relentless traffic, a reckless motorcyclist dangerously rode onto a sidewalk, terrifying pedestrians and aggressively confronting a visually impaired man who was using the guided path. As an outraged crowd gathered to confront the illegal rider for his blatant disregard for safety and decency, the blind man remarkably stepped in to shield his aggressor. Ultimately, his unexpected act of grace transformed a moment of hostility into a powerful lesson in compassion.
